notes: One block per pillar. effects: the elements the stat powers (from data), the caster's emission power for any of them, the point-buy dice that stat rolls. validation: code / pillar_role / zero_in unchanged, elements a non-empty subset of valid_element_ids, and every listed element's own `stat` column points back at this entry.

stat_vitality.description: Vitality (code V) is the physical pillar. It powers one element, elem_vitality: a caster emits Vitality with power stats.vitality and resists it with the same stat (Rule 18); its point-buy rolls point_buy_dice_count(vitality) dice (Rule 20); Force Shield's Vitality die is the shield value (pc). zero_in: undead and astral beings have Vitality 0 (species rule). Vitality counts fully in the stat sum that gives life (Rule 14).

prerequisites.description: The caster's stats carry a numeric vitality.

effects.description: Emission power for any Vitality element.
Kinds of being with this stat at 0.

validation.description: The stat code never changes.
The pillar role never changes.
elements is a non-empty subset of the ten element ids.
Every listed element's own stat column names this stat.
zero_in keeps the same set of kinds.

stat_world.description: World (code W, Souls / Spiritual) is the spiritual pillar, the manipulation of the time-space continuum. It powers three elements: elem_souls, elem_time and elem_space; a caster emits any of them with power stats.world and resists with the same stat (Rule 18); its point-buy rolls point_buy_dice_count(world) dice (Rule 20). zero_in: ordinary objects and plants have World 0; magical / ethereal beings have non-zero World (species rule).

stat_matter.description: Matter (code M, Ethereality) is the emotional pillar, the manipulation of matter and energy through the elements. It powers four elements: elem_air, elem_water, elem_earth and elem_fire; a caster emits any of them with power stats.matter and resists with the same stat (Rule 18), so Fireball (fire, fire) deals round_div10(2 x max(matter delta, 0)); its point-buy rolls point_buy_dice_count(matter) dice (15 -> 3, 8 -> 1, 9 -> 2). zero_in: non-magical objects have Matter 0.

stat_will.description: Will (code Wi) is the mental pillar: self-control and mental states. It powers two elements, elem_concentration and elem_harmony; a caster emits either with power stats.will and resists with the same stat (Rule 18); its point-buy rolls point_buy_dice_count(will) dice (Rule 20). Will also orders the choice of entry points at setup (Rule 0, highest first). zero_in: plants and most non-sentient beings have Will 0 (golems have Will 0).
